headline: Senate resolution that would have canceled a Veterans Affairs rule on reproductive health services did not advance.
what_it_does: This resolution would have used the Congressional Review Act to cancel a Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) rule titled "Reproductive Health Services." If adopted, the rule would have had no legal effect. The VA also would have been barred from issuing a substantially similar rule unless Congress later passed a law allowing it. No official summary was available, so the specific contents of the VA rule are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who get health care through the VA
who_it_affects.how: The reproductive health services available to them would have stayed as they were before the VA rule, rather than following the rule's changes.
The agency would have been blocked from enforcing this rule or issuing a substantially similar one without new approval from Congress.
